['Citroen Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Citroën is a French automobile brand that was founded in 1919 by André Citroën. It has been owned by Stellantis since 2021 and was previously part of the PSA Group. The company is known for its innovative technology, including the Traction Avant, the world's first car to be mass-produced with front-wheel drive, and the hydropneumatic self-levelling suspension system. Citroën has a history of producing award-winning cars and has been recognized with various national and international awards.

['DFS Deutsche Flugsicherung GmbH '].company_description: DFS Deutsche Flugsicherung GmbH is the company in charge of air traffic control for Germany. It is a company organized under private law and 100% owned by the Federal Republic of Germany. Since January 1993, DFS has been controlling air traffic in Germany. In Germany, military and civil air traffic controllers work side by side. Since 1994, DFS has been responsible for the handling of both civil and military air traffic in peacetime. Only military aerodromes are exempted from this integration.
